title: Subject: White swimsuit early afternoon
prompt: Subject: White swimsuit early afternoon Main Focus: one young adult female lying on her back on an ivory cushioned daybed by an outdoor pool. The character is placed large vertically in the center, focusing on the face, thighs, bent right knee, white bikini, left arm above head, and right hand by the side. Person/Expression: Small oval face, smooth bright skin under sunlight, dark brown almond eyes, natural thin eyebrows, small nose, glossy coral pink lips. Head tilted slightly left while looking at the overhead camera with a calm expression and slightly parted lips. Long eyelashes, thin eyeliner, natural cheek glow. Dark brown short bob hair nearly black reaching the jaw, thin bundled bangs on forehead, short strands around ears. Clothing/Pose: white triangle bikini with a slight pale lavender tint, thin halter string, two lines at the center under chest, bottom tied with a ribbon at the left hip. Lying on the back on the cushion, left arm bent overhead with fingertips touching bangs. Right arm lowered by the side with hand on the cushion. Left leg extended straight down, right knee raised high in the center foreground. Background/Light: Ivory long cushion and pillow with fine weave pattern under the character, black rattan frame. Pool surface with shaded blue tiles in the top left, beige stone tile floor and large gray pot at the top and right. Strong midday direct sunlight from above slightly left illuminates face, chest, abdomen, thighs, and knees clearly. Hard shadows of arms, legs, and fingers cast on the cushion, with subtle water reflections. Composition/Camera: 3:4 vertical. Near full-body lying portrait from a high overhead camera angled down from the foot of the daybed. Face in top-center, torso in center, bent right knee large in bottom-right. Legs naturally cut at the bottom edge. Sharp focus on face and body with deep depth of field showing background materials. Texture/Style: High-definition photorealistic photo taken in strong summer sunlight. Realistically depicts natural skin texture and sun glow, short hair bundles, smooth wet feeling of swimsuit, cushion weave, rattan, stone tiles, and blue water. Clear color palette of white, skin tone, beige, and blue, avoiding excessive skin smoothing or illustration style. Negative: Alteration of facial features, short bob, lying posture, or bent right knee.
